notes.title: Astro Prospector x Dark Fairy Tale: Dreamland Survivors Bundle!
notes.notes: [p]Hi, Rebels! 🫡[/p][p][/p][p]Today we have cool news! We are bundling with [b][i]Dark Fairy Tale: Dreamland Survivors[/i][/b]. This is an auto-shooting roguelite/survivor, where you play as Pinocchio 🤥[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3288300/Dark_Fairy_Tale_Dreamland_Survivors/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]If you like the Survivors genre, this bundle is a nice opportunity to enjoy two of them, as Astro Prospector is receiving a [b]free update with a new Survivors mode soon[/b]! 🚀[/p][p][/p][p]See you soon, Space Rebel! 👋[/p]

notes.title: 50.000 Copies Sold + New Survivors Mode in progress!
notes.notes: [p]Hi again, Rebels! 🫡[/p][p][/p][p]It has been [b]1 month[/b] since we launched Astro Prospector now, and we couldn't be happier! We have reached [b]50.000 copies sold[/b] and this is allowing us to work on a new BIG update for Astro! ☕[/p][p]Besides the copies sold, you have helped us reach [b]+1200 Overwhelmingly positive reviews[/b]. So thanks a lot for enjoying Astro Prospector that much, as we enjoy reading you & watching you play![/p][p][/p][p]So, the even better news... we're working on a [b]new Survivors Mode for Astro Prospector[/b]! 🥳[/p][p][i]What will this mode include?[/i] Well, we are in the early stages of development, but it will be a roguelite-style mode where you have to [b]finish a number of increasingly difficult waves and buy new upgrades between them[/b]. Think of super cool games like Brotato or Vampire Survivors![/p][p]Of course you will find there [b]new upgrades & weapons, new enemies & bosses, and even new ship types[/b]. We hope this mode will add lots of hours to the base game, as we are focusing on [b]replayability and creating unique builds [/b]each run. [/p][p]We want to release it around October, but can't confirm an exact date yet. And of course, this upgrade will be free for you all! 🚀[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539264/ce1a195b48929d4561b798eab75f9f0a4bcb796e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Finally, we already are more than [b]500 Astro members on our Discord Server[/b]! We invite you to join because we will be doing some [b]giveaways[/b] [b]soon[/b], and also will notice you about [b]playtesting[/b] the Survivors mode before anyone else! 🔔[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/ayqK4jukPY" style="button"]JOIN OUR DISCORD SERVER HERE[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Have a good day, and remember... F*ck SpaceCorp! ✊[/p]

notes.title: Astro Prospector - Patch #1 Changelog
notes.notes: [p]Hey there, Space Rebels! 🫡[/p][p]We have [b]released the first patch for Astro Prospector[/b]. This one is focused on some [i]small balance tweaks & bugfixing[/i], keeping the game challenging while accesible, and [i]adding some QoL features[/i], so your journey to obliterate SpaceCorp is smoother than ever! ✊[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Balance[/b][/h3][list][*][p]All no hit achievement has become no life lost achievement. Due to the amount of enemies in last zone, we decided it was more fair for the players to use their shield and dodge upgrades in order to clear this achievement[/p][/*][*][p]Reduce Sector 3 Zone 2 difficulty. Roots spawn less frequently, and stay alive for less time. Followers shooters (homing bullets) appear more distributed within the progress of the zone. We know this zone was one of the hardest one, and we want to keep the challenge but make it less frustrating[/p][/*][*][p]More collection radius for both early game and late game. Slurp all those AstroCoffee seeds![/p][/*][*][p]Bullets trails are more visible when bullet speed is reduced. In the last version, bullets trails disappeared when buying slow-down bullet speed upgrades, now trails are visible no matter what[/p][/*][*][p]Some small reworking on Sector 3 & 4 visuals, so it should be cleaner and easier to read when there are a lot of things on screen[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]New Features[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Support for up to 4K resolution[/p][/*][*][p]Include upgrade tree zoom with Q/E in the upgrades screen[/p][/*][*][p]Not collecting data for balancing anymore![/p][/*][*][p]Include new setting for confining or not the cursor inside the screen[/p][/*][*][p]Include new setting for preventing the game to run if it’s minimized/no focused[/p][/*][*][p]Hide player UI when ship is in top-left corner[/p][/*][*][p]Controls panel for Keyboard, Mouse and Controller[/p][/*][*][p]End panel when completing the game, showing time to complete game, hits received and runs losing all lifes, with some small text lore message.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Cursor is shown again when finishing the Credits screen with Lock mouse option enabled[/p][/*][*][p]Heartbeat on 5-5 boss is stopped when going back to upgrades screen[/p][/*][*][p]Don’t get randomly hit when destroying the Cofferoid in 5-5[/p][/*][*][p]Check all achievements on game start, to unlock those that weren’t unlocked when it was supposed to[/p][/*][*][p]Rebuild UI when changing language mid-game, so everything stays on place after the change[/p][/*][*][p]Backup system for save files. In case any of your save files get corrupted, we’re automatically saving a backup to try to read the information from that file and recover your game![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]That’s all for now! [b]We will keep listening to your opinions[/b]. We are now starting to work on the new content patch that will be releasing in September/October! 🥳[/p][p][/p][p]See you, Space Rebel ☕[/p]

notes.title: +15.000 Copies Sold + Astro Prospector Update Roadmap!
notes.notes: [p]Hi, Rebels! 🫡[/p][p][/p][p]It has been 3 days since we launched Astro Prospector and... wow! Your welcoming has exceed our biggest expectations. [b]+15.000 copies sold in just 3 days [/b]is crazy! Thanks A LOT for your interest and for enjoying Astro Prospector that much ☕[/p][p][/p][p]We also want to let you know about [b]Astro Prospector roadmap[/b]. It's focused on 2 big blocks![/p][olist][*][p][i]🐛 Quality of Life & Bugfixing: [/i]we will start working on a first patch focused on [b]fixing all the glitchs and errors[/b] you have reported during this days. Also, we want to add some [b]new settings[/b], more resolutions support (2K & 4K) and improve some harsh edges of the game. You can expect this patch around the end of July![/p][/*][*][p][i]🤸‍♀️ New Game Modes[/i]: we have heard you and our priority after bugfixing will be including some [b]new game modes for Astro Prospector[/b]. Maybe an endless mode? A roguelite mode? Boss rush? New Game+? There are lots of cool ideas that we want to implement, and will try to choose the best of them. Our idea is to let you enjoy the game all the time you want, so we [b]will to[/b] [b]focus on open-ended modes that allows for high replayability[/b]! You can expect this patch around September/October. [/p][p][/p][/*][/olist][p]Of course, all patches and new modes will be included as [b]free updates[/b] 😊[/p][p]Thanks again for all your love. We hope you continue enjoying Astro Prospector for a long time! 🥰[/p][p][/p][p]Have a good day, and remember... F*ck SpaceCorp! ✊[/p]

notes.title: Astro Prospector Playtest available now!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey there, Astro Prospectors! You can already send a request for participating on [b]Astro Prospector Playtest [/b]and enjoy the beta of Astro Prospector before launch! 🎮 [/p][p][/p][p]Astro Prospector Playtest is an [b]early version of the game[/b], including [i]4 out of 5 Sectors[/i], up to [i]6 different weapons[/i] and [i]150+ upgrades[/i]. You can expect around 3.5 hours of playtime, and you can also expect some [i]bugs[/i], broken balance and little glitches. But that's okay, because with your help we will release a super good version of Astro Prospector! 💓[/p][p][/p][p]So, [b]how can you request access[/b] for Astro Prospector Playtest? Easy![/p][p][/p][olist][*][p]First, go to the [b]Astro Prospector Steam page[/b]:

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3503440/Astro_Prospector/"][/dynamiclink][/p][/*][*][p]Click on the [b]green button "Request Access"[/b]:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539264/4815a2e7759eee24d144d392c405d30a36fd66a4.png"][/img]
[/p][/*][*][p][b]That's all! [/b]Now, you will have to wait some hours/days. We give access to bunchs of users every few days, when we update the playtest with changes and new content. But don't worry, this won't happen in the full released game, only in the playtest.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy Astro Prospector Playtest! If you have feedback or want to report bugs, please join our [url="https://discord.gg/ayqK4jukPY"]Discord [/url]or leave a message on [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3738150/discussions/"]Steam Discussions board[/url]![/p][p][/p][p]Have a good AstroDay! 🚀[/p]

notes.title: Astro Prospector Prologue is out now! 🚀
notes.notes:
Hey there, Space Rebels! We're announcing [b]Astro Prospector Prologue is out now[/b]! 🥳

This is a [b]40~ minutes demo[/b] of what Astro Prospector will be. Launch to space, mine cofferoids and come back to upgrade your ship on an incremental addictive loop. SpaceCorp machines will try to stop you. Dodge and hit'em back. Return AstroCoffee to humanity! ✊

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3512680/_/

[b]What can you find on the Prologue?[/b]

🗺️ [b]5 Zones[/b] with unique bosses and enemies.
📈 [b]30+ unique upgrades[/b] to become a space destruction machine.
🎮 [b]Full compatibility with controller[/b] and [b]Steam Deck[/b]!
🏆 [b]20+ Achivements[/b], some of them quite challenging (I'm looking at you, full No-Hit)
🗣️ [b]5 Languages[/b]: English, Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese & Japanese.
☕ [b]Lots and lots of AstroCoffee[/b]. Yummy.


If you like the Prologue, please [b]add Astro Prospector to your wishlist[/b]!

Also, you can [b]join [url=https://discord.com/invite/ayqK4jukPY]our Discord server[/url][/b] to follow the full game development and give us feedback 💖
